scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Awareness Campaign
other_conditions: Open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized agency or person
No individual or organization that has previously received the award may be considered for the next three award cycles
Only nominations or recommendations from authorized agencies or persons, supported by adequate justification, will be considered

For an outstanding awareness campaign, the eligible institution/organisation (excluding educational institutions) must have been innovative in creating awareness programmes, employed cost‑effective campaign methods reaching masses, achieved visible societal results, maintained consistent media visibility promoting an alcohol‑ and drug‑free lifestyle, have an internal policy for a drug‑free workplace, and educated the public about the adverse impacts of alcohol and drugs
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, memento and a cash prize of ₹4,00,000, plus travel, lodging and related expenses for themselves and one companion.
